_provenance: Written from the documented web_search_20250305 response shape (platform.claude.com docs, read 2026-08-03). NOT captured from the wire — run `corpus run ... --capture-search DIR` to replace it with a real one. Same status as the tweet-endpoint fixtures: it proves the parser and the fixture agree, not that either matches the API. The encrypted_content and encrypted_index values are placeholders — they are opaque to us by design, and a realistic-looking blob would buy nothing but a secrets-scanner finding.

citations.title: On rubrics — Jane Smith
citations.cited_text: Rubrics beat interviews because they force you to decide what you are measuring before you meet anyone.
